name: Lamia no Sato ~Lamia Harem de Shiborarete~
original_name: ラミアの里 ～ラミアはぁれむで搾られて～
source:
Having moved to the village of Lamis, a man who was once a hero enjoys
a lustful newlywed life with his beautiful and generous lamia wife.
One day during their sweet cumsuckery, his lamia wife's devotedness
drives herself to offer him a certain idea which stimulates his manstinct......?
